definitions.explanation: Long-term shifts in temperatures and weather patterns, especially those caused by human activities.

examples.japanese: {気候変動|きこうへんどう}は{世界的|せかいてき}な{課題|かだい}となっている。
examples.english: Climate change has become a global issue.

examples.japanese: {気候変動|きこうへんどう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{異常気象|いじょうきしょう}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Extreme weather events are increasing due to climate change.

examples.japanese: {気候変動|きこうへんどう}に{関|かん}する{国際会議|こくさいかいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An international conference on climate change was held.

notes:
{気候変動|きこうへんどう} is the standard Japanese term for "climate change."

WORD FORMATION:
{気候|きこう} (climate) + {変動|へんどう} (change, fluctuation) = {気候変動|きこうへんどう}

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気候変動|きこうへんどう}{対策|たいさく} - climate change measures
- {気候変動|きこうへんどう}の{影響|えいきょう} - effects of climate change
- {気候変動|きこうへんどう}{枠組|わくぐ}み{条約|じょうやく} - Framework Convention on Climate Change
- {気候変動|きこうへんどう}に{対処|たいしょ}する - to address climate change

{気候変動|きこうへんどう} VS {地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか}:
{地球温暖化|ちきゅうおんだんか} (global warming) refers specifically to rising temperatures, while {気候変動|きこうへんどう} (climate change) is broader, encompassing all shifts in climate patterns.
